name: io.github.2648782102/doodle-mcp
title: Doodle
description: Local-first two-way Excalidraw board where people and AI draw and sync intent through MCP.

environmentVariables.name: DOODLE_WORKSPACE_ROOT
environmentVariables.description: Optional workspace path scoped for read-only scan_project inspection.

environmentVariables.name: OUTPUT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional directory where .doodle/board.json and saved boards are persisted.

environmentVariables.name: PREVIEW_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Optional fixed local HTTP port for the fallback canvas; auto-selects a free port if unset.

environmentVariables.name: PREVIEW_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Optional local bind address for the fallback canvas HTTP server (defaults to 127.0.0.1).

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Optional stderr log verbosity level (defaults to info).
